name: frootbox/ai-anthropic
title: Anthropic
description: Claude by Anthropic as the AI provider of the website, with a monthly limit in the settings of the AI

name: frootbox/captcha-recaptcha
title: reCAPTCHA
description: reCAPTCHA of Google for the forms, v2 with a box or v3 with a score, loaded only after consent

name: frootbox/collections
title: Collections
description: Collections of entries of the same kind such as references, projects or show homes, with drafts, image, categories and tags, cards filtered by category and tag with an address for each entry, and some entries as teasers

name: frootbox/events
title: Events
description: Events with time, place, drafts and categories, a list of upcoming and past events with an address for each, the next events as teasers and a calendar file, and courses with free seats and a booking form from a provider

name: frootbox/forms
title: Forms
description: Forms built from field types, entries by mail and in the backend, spam protection with captchas of your choice and a spam folder

name: frootbox/google-fonts
title: Google Fonts
description: Search the catalog of Google Fonts and import fonts once, so visitors load them from the own domain

name: frootbox/jobs
title: Jobs
description: Jobs with kind, start, salary, workplace and drafts, a list filtered by category, kind and location with an address for each job, the application through a form and the newest jobs as teasers

name: frootbox/news
title: News
description: Articles with drafts and categories, a list with an address for each article, the newest articles as teasers and an RSS feed

name: frootbox/people
title: People and locations
description: The team, contact persons and locations with address, opening hours and a map, each with drafts

name: frootbox/search
title: Site search
description: Visitors find published pages, articles, events and more on the website

name: frootbox/seo
title: SEO
description: Sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph, structured data and a check of every page

name: frootbox/shop
title: Online shop
description: The catalog of a shop provider with categories and images, cart, sign-in of customers, checkout and their orders and invoices

name: frootbox/statistics
title: Statistics
description: Visits and page views without cookies or personal data, the most visited pages, where visitors come from and their devices

name: frootbox/storage-s3
title: S3 storage
description: Keep media and files from forms in an S3-compatible bucket and deliver public media from there

name: frootbox/webhooks
title: Webhooks
description: Tell other services about changes, signed after Standard Webhooks and sent in the background
